newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 21.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 21.

text.p: -- First Union Corp and Signet Banking Corp announced a definitive merger pact under which Signet shareholders would receive 0.55 share of First Union for each Signet share. The value of the deal is about $3.25 billion, the companies said. First Union said it would post an after-tax restructuring charge of $135 million in 1997. First Union's stock closed at 97-7/16 Friday while Signet closed at 36-11/16.
-- Sprint Corp plans to buy closely-held Paranet Inc for $425 million cash, the Wall Street Journal reported. Sprint closed at 45-9/16.

-- International Business Machines Corp is due to report second quarter earnings after the market closes. The First Call consensus earnings estimate is $1.42 per share, compared to $1.26 in the year-ago quarter. The stock finished at 104-3/16.

-- Rite Aid Corp has agreed to buy two closely-held drug store chains in Alabama and Louisiana, K&B Inc and Harco Inc. Rite Aid said it expects the deal to be accretive to earnings starting in the second quarter of 1998. Rite Aid closed at 48.
